resources.string: Place your phone flat on the mattress near your pillow, uncovered and well ventilated. Movement will be analyzed on this phone. Keep it still until you wake. Partners, pets, and mattress type can affect results.\n\nAwake, light, deep, and REM are experimental estimates, not measured sleep stages. Sensor tracking uses battery; choose Simple timer in Settings for sensor-free tracking.

Put your phone uncovered on the nightstand. The microphone will analyze ambient sound levels on this phone while tracking. Raw audio is never saved. A fan, partner, music, or pets can affect results.\n\nSound alone cannot reliably identify deep sleep or REM. The stage breakdown is an experimental estimate. Microphone capture uses battery and an ongoing notification.
Sound tracking needs microphone permission. Change the mode in Settings to use motion or the simple timer.

Experimental phone estimates from activity and time-of-night patterns. Deep and REM are not clinical measurements. Quiet wakefulness can look like sleep. Missing data stays unavailable.
